svg.title: GamingMaster network architecture
svg.desc: Per-game observation encoders turn each frame into a fixed set of tokens; two decision tokens are appended; a shared core of Stage-1 spatiotemporal blocks (spatial attention, per-token temporal mixer, feed-forward) and a Stage-2 recurrent-depth core (prelude, looped recurrent block, coda, optional mixture of experts and episode memory) processes them; per-game action decoders and a per-game value head read the result.
svg.text: identical weights for every game · frozen-reusable for a new game
tokens of one frame talk to each other
fixed-size memory → O(1) cost per step
no KV cache that grows with the match
think longer by looping, not by growing
inference: fixed r, fixed s₀ → replayable
reads the HL token · own scale per game
